partial class TestEntity : Entity<Guid>
{
    private TestEntity(Guid id, string name) : base(id)
    {
        Name = name;
    }

    internal static Result<TestEntity> Create(string name)
    {
        bool canCreate = true;
		Error error = Error.None;
        OnCreatingAuto(ref name, ref canCreate, ref error);
        OnCreating(ref name, ref canCreate, ref error);
    
        var result = new TestEntity(Guid.NewGuid(), name);
                                 
        OnCreated(result, ref canCreate, ref error);
        if(!canCreate) return Result.Failure<TestEntity>(error);

        

        return Result.Success(result);
    }
    
    internal Result<bool> Update(string name)
    {
        bool canUpdate = true;
		Error error = Error.None;
        OnUpdatingAuto(ref name, ref canUpdate, ref error);
        OnUpdating(ref name, ref canUpdate, ref error);
        
        var tmpName = Name;
        Name = name;
        
        OnUpdated(ref canUpdate, ref error);
        if(!canUpdate)
        {
           Name = tmpName;
           return Result.Failure<bool>(error);
        }
        

        return Result.Success(true);
    }

    private static void OnCreatingAuto(ref string name, ref bool canCreate, ref Error error)
    {
        OnCreatingName(ref name, ref canCreate, ref error);
    }

    private void OnUpdatingAuto(ref string name, ref bool canUpdate, ref Error error)
    {
        OnUpdatingName(ref name, ref canUpdate, ref error);
    }

    static partial void OnCreated(TestEntity result, ref bool canCreate, ref Error error);

    partial void OnUpdated(ref bool canUpdate, ref Error error);
